tools.name: host.tool_list
tools.description: List this tenant's published tools.

tools.name: host.tool_remove
tools.description: Remove a published tool by its local name.

tools.name: host.tool_logs
tools.description: Return the most recent log lines for one of this tenant's tools.

tools.name: host.tool_test
tools.description: Dry-run a published tool: performs the real call but records no `calls` row and echoes the rendered request back with secrets redacted, for debugging a spec.

tools.name: host.bridge_test
tools.description: Dry-run an `http`-kind spec (typically a declarative REST-bridge `upstream` spec) against its real upstream without publishing it: no tool is created, no `calls` row is written, and the rendered request is echoed back with secrets redacted, same as host.tool_test but for a spec you haven't published

tools.description: Debug run of a published tool: the same sandbox and limits as a real call, but returns full stdout and stderr (each capped at 64 KiB) and the exit code alongside the result, and records no `calls` row and no metering. tools.description: Invoke a tool this tenant has already published, by its local name -- the same real, metered call as calling it directly by its namespaced name (<namespace>.<name>), for a session that has no way to see its own namespaced tool name yet. Unlike host.tool_test, this counts toward host.usage and appear

tools.name: host.usage
tools.description: Calls, errors and duration percentiles for this tenant over a window.

tools.name: host.secret_set
tools.description: Store an encrypted secret value under this tenant's namespace.

tools.name: host.secret_list
tools.description: List this tenant's secret names (never their values).

tools.name: host.registry_publish
tools.description: Publish this tenant's server.json to the configured MCP registry (requires --registry-url and admin.tenant_verify_namespace first).

tools.name: host.state.get
tools.description: Read one key from this tenant's key-value state namespace. Returns found: false (not an error) if the key was never set.

tools.name: host.state.set
tools.description: Write one key in this tenant's key-value state namespace; value may be any JSON value. Overrun of the plan's state_bytes_max quota fails with state_quota_exceeded and writes nothing.

tools.name: host.state.delete
tools.description: Delete one key from this tenant's key-value state namespace.

tools.name: host.state.list
tools.description: List keys (with their current values) in this tenant's key-value state namespace, optionally filtered by prefix.

tools.name: host.state.table_create
tools.description: Declare (or replace the schema of) a table in this tenant's state store. schema is {"column": "text"|"integer"|"real"|"boolean"|"json"}; primary_key, if given, must name one of schema's columns -- an insert whose row matches an existing row's primary_key value replaces it.

tools.name: host.state.table_drop
tools.description: Drop a declared table and every row it holds.

tools.name: host.state.insert
tools.description: Insert one row (an object) or several (an array of objects) into a declared table. Each row is validated against the table's schema first -- a type mismatch fails the whole call with state_schema_violation and writes nothing.

tools.name: host.state.query
tools.description: Read rows from a declared table, optionally filtered (where: "field op value", ops = != < <= > >=, clauses joined by ' and '), ordered (order_by: "field" or "field desc") and capped (limit).

tools.name: host.state.delete_rows
tools.description: Delete rows from a declared table matching an optional where filter (same grammar as host.state.query); omitting where deletes every row in the table.

tools.name: billing.plans
tools.description: The plan catalog (price and quotas per plan) and whether Stripe billing is configured on this host. Anonymous callers get the same answer as tenants.

tools.name: billing.status
tools.description: This tenant's plan, usage against each quota, and when the daily call quota resets.

tools.name: billing.checkout
tools.description: Create (or reuse an open one for the same plan) a Stripe Checkout URL to upgrade this tenant, defaulting to the pro plan. Returns billing_unavailable if this host has no Stripe key configured -- call billing.plans first to check.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: host.tool_publish, billing.checkout · Private data: host.tool_test, host.bridge_test, host.tool_run, host.secret_set, host.secret_list · Public sink: host.tool_publish, host.registry_publish · Destructive: host.tool_publish, host.tool_remove, host.tool_test, host.bridge_test, host.tool_run, host.state.delete, host.state.table_drop, host.state.delete_rows.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: host.tool_publish, billing.checkout · Private data: host.tool_test, host.bridge_test, host.tool_run, host.secret_set, host.secret_list · Public sink: host.tool_publish, host.registry_publish · Destructive: host.tool_publish, host.tool_remove, host.tool_test, host.bridge_test, host.tool_run, host.state.delete, host.state.table_drop, host.state.delete_rows

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
